disambiguation: Not a general Pomodoro timer or invoicing tool; it is a process-insight tool specifically for repeatable checklists.
intentEvidence: Times how long each item in a checklist takes, so you can see which steps in a recurring process — a weekly review, a deploy checklist, any process you run more than once — are actually eating the time.
problem: Users often lack visibility into how long individual steps of a recurring process or checklist actually takes to complete.
summary: A process-insight tool that times the duration of each item within a checklist to identify time bottlenecks in repeatable workflows.
